source_scoring_rule: A checker proves the submitted formal statement within its profile. Whether that statement faithfully captures the source remains unmeasured without separate valid evidence. automated_structural_correctness.description: Parse, typed elaboration, declared compiler contracts, source-map mechanics, and reconstruction agreement labeled by producer.

exact_goal_native_checker_acceptance.description: Native checker acceptance or explicit failure of the exact declared goal and premises under a pinned checker identity. Not source-meaning equivalence.

teacher_agreement.description: Automatic teacher, compiler/view, or reconstruction agreement against producer-declared targets. Mock embeddings remain diagnostics only.

learned_updates.description: Actual training update, loss, checkpoint, seed, split, and cost records. Parameter change is not held-out fidelity.

constructed_conformance.description: Finite constructed witnesses with predefined expected distinctions. Not natural-document semantic gold or unbounded soundness.

unmeasured_human_semantic_fidelity.description: Independent human source-facet labels, agreement, and adjudication. Currently not collected.
